design.real-Windows-files: Use retained file handle and stable private IOSB/OVERLAPPED-prefix/output boxes. Never reopen normal files or forward guest pointers/handles. GetOverlappedResult(FALSE) observes any pending completion without requiring SYNCHRONIZE. V7 validates prefix completion for regular,directory,async-opened and shared-output handles with grants0/SYNCHRONIZE; all observed calls completed immediately.
design.portable-mapped-files: A Windows DriveMap on Unix represents a virtual mounted Windows disk with captured profile(7,0x20020). It does not report Unix hardware flags as Windows bits. Metadata-only path handles revalidate identity.
design.IOSB-reserved-upper-word: Native64 status union upper32 bits are zeroed deterministically. Native shared-filesystem providers can leave this reserved word unchanged; defined NTSTATUS32 and Information are the conformance fields.
design.rejected-v6: ReOpenFile fails for directory handles; shared backend FileIdInfo is unavailable. Rejected controls retained; no reopen path used for retained normal files.
